::: {.callout-note}
## Known to exist — copy sought
Two independent 1987–89 public sources inspected in this catalogue attest that a formal / independent evaluation of Creekview was completed or published around 1987. The exact title “Creekview 202 Project Evaluation Report” and the author line “Patricia Ryan / Ryan & Wiggins” still come only from [jordanforge-infrastructure issue 10](https://github.com/jordanforge-ca/jordanforge-infrastructure/issues/10). This archive has not inspected the evaluation itself or a library catalogue record for that title or those authors.
:::

## Identification

| Element | What is attested, and from where |
| --- | --- |
| Title as first named for this archive | Creekview 202 Project Evaluation Report |
| Creator as first named for this archive | Patricia Ryan / Ryan & Wiggins |
| Date as first named for this archive | c. 1987 |
| Independent 1987 attestation that an evaluation existed | [Mattinson and Rompf, *Dimensions in Health Service* 64(8), Nov. 1987](1987-mattinson-rompf-creekview.qmd), PubMed PMID 3691990 abstract: “A formal evaluation of the Creekview project has been completed by the B.C. provincial government and CPA.” Topics listed: operating costs; health status at relocation and one year later; quality of attendant staff; standards of care; general services. |
| Independent 1989 attestation of a published 1987 evaluation | [Haw 1989](1989-haw-special-housing-needs.qmd): “In 1987 an independent evaluation of Creekview 202 was published.” Haw paraphrases cost, health-status, and accreditation findings. |
| Contemporaneous legislative setting | [Hansard, 24 Feb. 1984](1984-hansard-mowat-creekview.qmd) (planned Creekview Co-op move); [Hansard, 10 Apr. 1986](1986-hansard-nielsen-creekview.qmd) (ministerial statement that six residents had moved). |
| Later organizational history | [SCI BC history page](sci-bc-history.qmd) dates Creekview’s opening to 1985. |
| Attributed resident account | [Fayerman 2018](2018-vancouversun-walt-lawrence.qmd) reports Walt Lawrence on a 1985 Creekview move and an earlier CPA cost analysis. |

No place of publication, pagination, report number, or title-page wording for the evaluation itself has been seen in a catalogue record. CMHC searches in this pass did **not** recover a CMHC publication that cites “Creekview 202 Project Evaluation Report.”

## What this pass actually inspected

Inspected: PubMed record and abstract for Mattinson & Rompf 1987; Haw’s 1989 conference text; Hansard 1984 and 1986; SCI BC history; Fayerman 2018.

Not inspected: the evaluation report; the full *Dimensions in Health Service* article; any WorldCat, UBC, SFU, or Legislative Library holding for Patricia Ryan or Ryan & Wiggins.

Internet Archive advanced search for the title “Creekview 202 Project Evaluation” returned zero items (searched 20 September 2026).

Haw’s three findings and Mattinson/Rompf’s topic list are **their summaries**, not an inspection of the 1987 report.

## Authorship contradiction (do not reconcile)

- Early project notes: Patricia Ryan / Ryan & Wiggins.
- Mattinson & Rompf 1987 abstract: “B.C. provincial government and CPA.”
- Haw 1989: “an independent evaluation,” no author named.

Those may describe one report with multiple credits, two related documents, or different works. This archive does not pick a winner.

## Annotation

Public evidence now independently confirms that contemporaries treated a 1987 Creekview evaluation as a completed, published document. It does **not** confirm the Ryan / Ryan & Wiggins authorship, the exact title-page wording, or contents beyond later paraphrase.

## Open questions

- Where a copy now lives.
- Exact title-page wording, date, pagination, and issuing body.
- Whether Patricia Ryan / Ryan & Wiggins appear on that title page.
- What “202” refers to.
- How the 1987 evaluation relates to the CPA “cost analysis” in Fayerman 2018 and to the Mattinson & Rompf article.
- Whether any CMHC 1990s bibliography cites this report (not found in this pass).

## Recovery leads for Issue #6

This reconstruction did not hunt new archives. Leads already on this record, plus items the Creekview chapter now makes more specific:

- Full text of Mattinson and Rompf 1987, *Dimensions in Health Service* 64(8) — UBC / SFU / Legislative Library / CINAHL holdings.
- Library or archival catalogue records for the evaluation title and for Patricia Ryan / Ryan & Wiggins (still unfound on the public web).
- Ministry of Health estimates files around Nielsen’s 10 April 1986 sitting (he refers to Paraplegic Association correspondence and a photograph received “yesterday”).
- CPA / BCPA / SCI BC project files; Haw 1989 also names a then-developing “Nobel House Cooperative” as taking the Creekview 202 concept further (do not silently equate with SCI BC history’s Stanley Noble Stronge project).

Do not host a recovered scan unless redistribution is clearly permitted.
